objective: Create an auditable candidate-selection plan that addresses joint state coverage across source runs without using outcome/model-score driven picking or reusing old evaluations as blind tests.
allowed: Read existing saved full states, valid-action masks, input features, source-run identity and source hashes
Deduplicate exact state identities while preserving run provenance; do not equate serialized SHA uniqueness with independent physical states
Design input-only stratification / selection and verify cross-source coverage before fixing candidate count
Reference already collected returns only to avoid duplicate collection, not to choose favorable candidates
not_allowed: No new MCTS calls or state transitions
No new hard labels for the10UNKNOWN states
No rewriting old results or paths
No claiming the development pool is an independent route test
pass_standard: Selection algorithm, candidate count, tie rules, masks, grouping, duplicate handling and input hashes are explicitly frozen BEFORE reading any future teacher returns
Source records and full-state identities trace to exact known inputs
Both vehicles' route progress/speed configurations are represented across the declared source groups, with remaining uncovered regions reported rather than hidden
Future data identified as post-result same-route development; historical metrics remain immutable
hold_standard: Any missing source identity, ambiguous model/action semantics, or unresolved selection rule remains HOLD; do not compensate with fabricated data or unapproved collection.
